en: What if phones had never been invented?
zh: 如果從來沒有發明電話？

en: This morning I suddenly wondered about it… and I couldn't stop thinking!
zh: 今天早上我突然想到這個問題……一直想個不停！

en: The telephone was invented in 1876. Before that, talking to someone far away wasn't easy at all!
zh: 電話是一八七六年發明的。在那以前，想跟遠方的人說話，可沒那麼簡單喔！
say: The telephone was invented in eighteen seventy-six. Before that, talking to someone far away wasn't easy at all!

en: I want to talk to Grandma, who lives far away. With no phone, I'd have to write her a letter.
zh: 我想跟住在很遠的奶奶說話。沒有電話，我只能寫一封信給她。

en: The letter rides in the mail truck and takes days to arrive. When Grandma writes back, I wait days again!
zh: 信要坐郵差的車，好幾天才會到。奶奶回信，我又要再等好幾天！

en: Our family goes on a trip and gets lost! No map app, so Dad has to unfold a giant paper map.
zh: 全家出去玩，結果迷路了！沒有地圖App，爸爸只好打開一張超大的紙地圖。

en: Want to play with my best friend? I'd run to his house and knock: "Is Xiaoming home? Can he come out to play?"
zh: 想找好朋友玩？我就跑到他家門口敲門：「小明在家嗎？可以出來玩嗎？」
say: Want to play with my best friend? I'd run to his house and knock. Is Xiao Ming home? Can he come out to play?

en: If someone gets hurt or there's a fire, nobody can call for help. Someone has to run as fast as they can to get a doctor or firefighters!
zh: 如果有人受傷或失火了，沒辦法打一一九。得有人用最快的速度跑去找醫生和消防員！

en: Maybe everyone would send notes by pigeon! People long ago really trained homing pigeons to fly messages home.
zh: 說不定大家會用鴿子送信！以前的人真的會訓練信鴿，讓牠們飛回家送消息喔。

en: On the bus there are no phone games. I'd read a book, watch the clouds out the window, or chat with the person next to me.
zh: 坐公車的時候不能玩手機遊戲。我會看書、看窗外的雲，或是跟旁邊的人聊天。

en: Without phones, lots of things would be slower and harder. But at dinner, maybe everyone would look at each other and talk more.
zh: 沒有電話，很多事會變慢、變麻煩。可是吃晚飯的時候，大家也許會多看看彼此、多聊聊天。

en: Today's words: if, telephone, invent, write a letter, map, friend.
zh: 今天學到的生詞：如果、電話、發明、寫信、地圖、朋友。

en: What do you think? Would you want to live in a world without phones? Why?
zh: 你覺得呢？你想住在一個沒有電話的世界嗎？為什麼？
